preApprovalId.description: The ID of the pre-approval. Parameter cannot be NULL.

toFri.description: The Financial Resource Identifier of the receiving account.

fromFri.description: The Financial Resource Identifier of the sending account.

fromCurrency.description: The currency of the account holder from where the debit happens. ISO4217 Currency

createdTime.description: The date and time at which the pre-approval was created. Validated with IsIso8601DateTime. Parameter can not be NULL

approvedTime.description: The date and time at which the pre-approval was approved. Validated with IsIso8601DateTime. Parameter can not be NULL.

expiryTime.description: The date and time at which the pre-approval expires. Validated with IsIso8601DateTime. Parameter can not be NULL.

message.description: Message. Validated with IsRestirctedString. Parameter can not be NULL.

startDate.description: The start date of the pre-approval. Validated with IsDateString. Parameter can not be NULL.

lastUsedDate.description: The date pre-approval was used last. Validated with IsIso8601DateTime. Parameter can not be NULL.

offer.description: The offer description. Validated with IsRestrictedString. Parameter can not be NULL.

externalId.description: The external reference id. Validated with IsExternalReferenceString. Parameter can not be NULL.

maxDebitAmount.description: The max debit amount allowed. Contains a non-negative amount. Validated with IsAmount.
